rates.note: Whole-aircraft planning range before positioning, trip charges and taxes.

name: Jet Partners
roleBasis: Says it has been "arranging private jet charter since 2010" and tells buyers to review the "identified carrier, aircraft, complete price, and trip terms in a written proposal before booking".
summary: Charter arranger with a pricing page of planning ranges and a quote page that tells buyers what to compare.
differentiator: Its quote page lists what to compare between proposals: total price, taxes, charter-arranger and carrier charges, third-party charges, and what happens if the aircraft is substituted. It links the FAA Part 135 list, and its planning ranges sit with the high group, not the low group.
priceNote: Its calculator shows, for example, $19,500 to $36,500 one way for a light jet from Teterboro to Miami Opa-locka with six passengers, marked "Planning estimate, not a live quote". It says a written proposal controls the final price.
operatorDisclosure: Says its written proposal identifies the carrier and aircraft before booking. It shows ARGUS, Wyvern and IS-BAO logos with the note "A logo does not guarantee a particular flight".
bestFor: Buyers who want a checklist of what to compare between proposals, and a planning range that is not a base rate.
skipIf: You are comparing against base-rate tables and expect similar numbers. Its ranges are a different basis.
